name: HTML
note: The document is the data structure. Every board here keeps its state in inputs — radio groups for a choice, checkbox banks for a bit field, an id for a fragment gate — because those are the only things a stylesheet can read.
ground: The URL splits in two and only half of it reaches CSS. The fragment is readable through :target; the query string is not readable at all. That is why the script layer signals on ?run and dev mode on ?dev — a channel the stylesheet cannot see cannot collide with it.
ask: What state does this hold, and could the stylesheet alone read it?
